summary: On October 1, 2026, Global Asset Management Group, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the start of OTCQB Venture Market trading under symbol GAMG and two leadership appointments: Steven Horne as Chief Growth Officer and Bruce M. Arinaga as strategic advisor to the Board. The filing states no stake, price per share, implied value, premium, advisor, or board recommendation, and the changes were announced additions rather than abrupt departures. Mechanics are administrative, with the press release furnished under Item 8.01 and exhibits under Item 9.01. What to watch: execution on new growth initiatives and any subsequent capital or transaction activity.
